short_description:
Vice Replay VS: GTA 6 vs Red Dead Redemption 2 in three rounds. Critics: 99 vs 97 on Metacritic (VGC, Notebookcheck). Length: about 80 hours (Rockstar's estimate, story plus some side missions; GamesRadar, TechRadar) vs about 51 (HowLongToBeat). Launch: $3.79 billion from pre-orders plus day one (Take-Two, Nov 20, 2026) vs $725 million in Red Dead 2's first three days (Take-Two, Oct 2018; Shacknews, GamesRadar, CNBC). Not the same measure: GTA 6's number includes months of pre-orders. Is Red Dead still Rockstar's best?

Sources: VGC, Notebookcheck, GamesRadar, TechRadar, HowLongToBeat, Take-Two, Shacknews, CNBC.
